excerpt: FENDI’s Spring/Summer 2027 Baguette 26424 features a black-and-white lambskin and calfskin design with gold studs, inspired by a 1933 archive suitcase.
author: 撰稿 X LING 编辑 X VIVI

blocks.text: For Spring/Summer 2027, FENDI introduces the Baguette® 26424 in a striking black-and-white colorway, inspired by a heritage suitcase from the house's 1933 archives. The body is crafted from white lambskin, while black calfskin and gold studs define the frame, lending the piece a rebellious, punk-inflected attitude.
· Baguette® 26424 ·

FENDI's Spring/Summer 2027 runway show explored the relationship between the body and clothing. Chief Creative Officer Maria Grazia Chiuri took undergarments—the layer closest to the skin—as her starting point, transforming fabric into a second skin through lace, embroidery, and cutout details, striking a delicate balance between restraint and ease.

Maria Grazia Chiuri Fashion Designer Born 1964 Nationality Italian Alma mater Istituto Europeo di Design, Rome Career Co-Creative Director at Valentino (2008–2016), Creative Director of Womenswear at Dior (2016–2025), Chief Creative Officer at Fendi (2025–present)
FENDI Spring/Summer 2027 Runway

The Baguette® 26424 once again took center stage this season. First unveiled in FENDI's Fall/Winter 2026 collection, the Baguette® 26424 revives the silhouette and style code 26424 of the original 1997 baguette, symbolizing a return to the source.
FENDI Spring/Summer 2027 Runway
FENDI Spring/Summer 2027 Campaign (Swipe for more images)

In the late 1990s, minimalism was in full swing—and it was against this backdrop that the FENDI Baguette was born in 1997. Its design drew from a compact, pared-back silhouette: light enough to tuck under the arm, carrying only the essentials. The Baguette boldly challenged the prevailing minimalist aesthetic, breaking through the monotony of monochrome dressing with vivid color clashes, rich craftsmanship, and daring material innovations. It became a statement of FENDI's maverick spirit and, thanks to its ability to express the wearer's individuality, quickly evolved into a coveted cultural symbol and fashion must-have.

The Baguette® 26424 stays true to the original baguette design—a compact, elongated silhouette with a flap closure, centered on the clean FF magnetic clasp that can be opened and closed with one hand, and finished with an adjustable, detachable short strap.
· Contrast Leather & Metal Studs ·
The standout feature of this bag is undoubtedly the black-and-white contrast and stud detailing, inspired by FENDI's Pergamena collection of suitcases from 1933.
Pergamena collection suitcases, FENDI, 1933

The bag is made from supple 'Pergamena' (parchment-colored) lambskin, with a fine, paper-like texture visible up close. Soft black nappa calfskin defines the frame, strap, and other details, while the black-and-white contrast creates striking visual tension and a gender-neutral appeal.
Zoom in Click to enlarge for ultra-clear detail

Gold conical studs are meticulously set along the black calfskin frame, continuing from the sides all the way to the base. From front, side, and back, the studs lend a confident edge reminiscent of a tough leather jacket, exuding a rebellious, avant-garde spirit.
The studs are crafted from gold-tone brass with a mirror-polished finish, catching the light with a gleaming golden shine.
Zoom in Click to enlarge for ultra-clear detail
The studs on the base also serve as protective feet, shielding the bottom from wear and tear—so you can set it down without worry.
Zoom in Click to enlarge for ultra-clear detail
· Handle & Strap ·
With the short strap, the bag works as a compact handbag. You can also tuck it under your arm, which visually elongates the silhouette and evokes a touch of Y2K aesthetics.
A long adjustable and detachable strap, designed to echo the bag's detailing, is also included—crafted in black calfskin with gold studs for an even more punk-rock look when worn.
· What Fits Inside ·
Open the bag to reveal a sleek black lining in soft black nappa calfskin, featuring an interior zip pocket and a gold-stamped logo.

We packed a wallet, phone, notebook, keys, perfume, and lipstick inside. The soft-bodied silhouette could actually hold more, but given the delicate leather, it's best to keep it to simple daily essentials.
· Fashion Look ·

This studded baguette has serious attitude—its gender-neutral style works effortlessly for anyone, and the black-and-white palette is a classic that won't date. This season FENDI also offers a range of options including FF jacquard canvas, black-and-white tiger-print calf hair, and all-black lambskin, all grounded by studded trim for a cool, edgy feel.
FENDI Baguette® 26424 Bag Designer Silvia Venturini Fendi Dimensions 26cm long, 14cm high, 4cm deep Weight 565g Retail price ¥39,600

Fendi is a renowned Italian fur and handbag brand from Rome, founded in 1925 by Adele Casagrande and Edoardo Fendi. Its logo—a symmetrical motif of two interlocking 'F's—was created by German fashion designer and brand creative director Karl Lagerfeld. since 1925 from Rome
